Elephant linked to 16 deaths tranquilized and radio-collared in Chhattisgarh

An elephant, believed to be responsible for 16 deaths, has been captured and fitted with a radio collar in Chhattisgarh following a six-day operation. The operation to tranquilize and collar the animal concluded after nearly a week.
